# CR-004 — SmartGift tenant + LINE OA onboarding / เปิด tenant SmartGift และเชื่อม LINE OA

**Status:** approved (Boss, 2026-08-09) · **Mode:** DDD
**Plan ref:** SmartGift `docs/implementation-plan-2026-08-09.md` §5 (ZUMP01 Phase 2) · **Depends on:** CR-003 (gate G1)

## Problem / ปัญหา

SmartGift needs to exist as a Zuri tenant with its LINE OA wired to the existing webhook so real
customer messages land in Inbox. The webhook, HMAC verification and per-tenant routing
(`destination` → `lineOaId`, ADR-056) already work — **no new webhook code is needed**. What is
missing is (a) a repeatable, idempotent way to create the tenant and store its LINE credentials,
(b) a read-only verifier proving the wiring is correct before traffic is switched on, and (c) a
runbook for the steps only a human can do (create the OA, obtain credentials, set the webhook URL).
Zuri มี webhook + HMAC + routing ต่อ tenant อยู่แล้ว — CR นี้ไม่แตะโค้ด webhook สิ่งที่ขาดคือวิธี onboard tenant
แบบทำซ้ำได้, ตัวตรวจก่อนเปิด traffic, และ runbook สำหรับขั้นตอนที่มนุษย์ต้องทำเอง

**Latent security defect found during recon (defence in depth — fixed here, see the reachability
note below):** `PATCH /api/tenant/integrations` — the endpoint that writes LINE/Facebook
credentials — takes its tenant id from the **client-supplied `x-tenant-id` header** (`route.js:15`)
and passes it straight to `updateTenantIntegrations()` →
`prisma.tenant.update({ where: { id: tenantId } })`. The Prisma `$extends` tenant guard cannot
catch this: `Tenant` has no `tenantId` column, so the guard skips the model. Structurally this is
a cross-tenant credential write.

**Reachability (verified at the 2026-08-09 review gate — do not overstate this in the merge
record):** it is **not exploitable today**, for two independent reasons. (a) `src/middleware.js:238`
deletes any client-supplied `x-tenant-id` on every `/api/*` request and re-sets it from the
verified NextAuth token; Next is pinned above the CVE-2025-29927 middleware-bypass range.
(b) `permissionMatrix.js` has no `tenant` domain entry for any role, so `can(roles,'tenant','F')`
is `false` for everyone and the endpoint currently returns 403 to all callers — including OWNER.
The fix still belongs here: it removes middleware as the single barrier, and it must land
**before** the ACL gap is closed, or the hole becomes live the moment that endpoint starts
answering. Closing the ACL gap (and the identical one on `PATCH /api/tenant/config`) is a separate
follow-up CR — it turns two currently-dead endpoints on and needs its own tests.

## Change / การแก้

| # | Piece | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Security fix** — `src/app/api/tenant/integrations/route.js` | Derive the tenant from `session.user.tenantId` (as every other gated route does). If an `x-tenant-id` header is present **and differs**, return `403 TENANT_MISMATCH` rather than silently ignoring it — a mismatch means either a bug or an attempt. Keep the existing `{ domain: 'tenant', action: 'W' }` ACL (that one *is* enforced by `withAuth`, unlike the no-op `roles` option noted in CR-003). |
| 2 | **Defence in depth** — `src/lib/repositories/tenantRepo.js` | `updateTenantIntegrations(tenantId, data, { expectedTenantId })` — when `expectedTenantId` is supplied and differs from `tenantId`, throw before touching the database. The route passes the session tenant. Existing callers keep working (parameter optional). |
| 3 | **Onboarding script** `scripts/onboard/tenant-line-oa.mjs` (new) | Idempotent CLI: upsert the tenant row (`tenantSlug`, `tenantName`, `plan`, `currency`, `timezone`, `vatRate` from flags/env) and set LINE config from **environment variables only** — `LINE_OA_ID`, `LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET`, `LINE_CHANNEL_TOKEN`. Tokens are encrypted through the existing `encryptToken` path (reuse `updateTenantIntegrations`, never write the columns raw). **Never print a secret** — log booleans/lengths only. `--dry-run` prints the plan and exits. Re-running with the same inputs is a no-op update. |
| 4 | **Preflight verifier** `scripts/verify/line-oa.mjs` (new) | Read-only, mirrors the style of `scripts/verify/tenant-guard.mjs`. Checks and prints PASS/FAIL per item: tenant row exists and is active · `lineOaId` set · `lineChannelSecret` present and decryptable · `lineChannelToken` present and decryptable · no *other* tenant shares the same `lineOaId` (routing collision would send messages to the wrong tenant) · `getTenantByLineOaId(lineOaId)` resolves back to this tenant · consent surface ready (`CONSENT_VERSION` importable, tenant slug resolvable for the LIFF consent URL). Exit non-zero on any FAIL. **Prints no secret values.** |
| 5 | **Runbook** `docs/runbooks/RUNBOOK-line-oa-onboarding.md` (new) | The human steps, in order, with the gates called out: ① DPA signed (merge gate — legal, not code) ② CR-003 deployed and the LIFF consent page reachable ③ create/obtain the LINE OA, Messaging API channel, and copy Channel secret + long-lived access token ④ set the three env vars locally ⑤ `node scripts/onboard/tenant-line-oa.mjs --slug smartgift --dry-run` then for real ⑥ `node scripts/verify/line-oa.mjs --slug smartgift` — all PASS ⑦ set the webhook URL in the LINE console to `https://<domain>/api/webhooks/line` and enable "Use webhook" ⑧ send one test message from a personal LINE account → confirm it appears in Inbox ⑨ configure the rich menu in LINE Official Account Manager (4 buttons per the design doc: catalogue LIFF, request quote, track order, talk to staff) — done in the LINE console, not by this repo. Include a rollback line: disable the webhook in the LINE console; credentials can be cleared by re-running onboarding with empty env values. |
| 6 | **Tests** | Route: header-mismatch → 403, no header → uses session tenant, ACL denial preserved. Repo: `expectedTenantId` mismatch throws before any Prisma call. Script helpers: argument/env parsing and the redaction helper (assert a secret value never appears in produced log lines). Follow existing route-test mock patterns; `vi.mock` at top level. |

## Acceptance Criteria / เกณฑ์ยอมรับ

- **AC1** Given an authenticated user of tenant A, When they PATCH `/api/tenant/integrations`
  with `x-tenant-id: <tenant B>`, Then the response is 403 and tenant B's credentials are
  unchanged (test asserts no Prisma write occurred).
- **AC2** Given no `x-tenant-id` header, When the PATCH succeeds, Then the write targets the
  session's tenant.
- **AC3** Running the onboarding script twice with identical inputs leaves the same DB state
  (idempotent) and no secret value appears in stdout/stderr in either run.
- **AC4** With credentials in place, `scripts/verify/line-oa.mjs` exits 0 and every check reads
  PASS; with `lineOaId` cleared, it exits non-zero naming the failed check. A second tenant
  sharing the same `lineOaId` is reported as FAIL.
- **AC5** `npm run lint` + targeted vitest green; full suite no new failures. Script-level tests
  (`node --test`) must actually execute in CI/pre-commit — a test file that no runner picks up is
  not evidence (added as `npm run test:scripts` at the review gate).
- **AC6** The verifier reads credentials from the **database only**. Given a tenant whose
  credential columns are null while `LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET`/`LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN` are set in
  the operator's environment or `.env.local`, it must FAIL — never PASS on the operator's own
  shell. (Regression test required: this was a blocker at the 2026-08-09 review gate, and it
  would have green-lit switching real customer traffic onto a tenant with no stored credentials.)

## Out of scope / นอกขอบเขต

- **Creating the LINE OA, obtaining credentials, setting the webhook URL, and building the rich
  menu** — human/console steps (runbook §③⑦⑨). This repo never calls the LINE API to mutate OA
  configuration, and no credential is committed.
- **Per-tenant LIFF id.** `NEXT_PUBLIC_LIFF_ID` is a single global env var
  (`(liff)/liff/[tenantSlug]/page.jsx:31`); SmartGift is the only LIFF tenant today so one LIFF
  app is correct for now. Multi-tenant LIFF (per-tenant `liffId` column + client lookup) is a
  follow-up CR — flagged so the next tenant does not silently share SmartGift's LIFF app.
- Historical customer import (design doc forbids uploading the 3,569 local records), message
  backfill (FEAT-004 stub), Facebook channel onboarding, and the `DEFAULT_TENANT_ID` fallback in
  the webhook (unresolved-destination path) — unchanged here.

## Rollout / การปล่อย

No schema change. Merge order: **#122 (G0) → #123 (CR-003) → this CR**, and the LINE webhook is
switched on in the console only after the runbook's gates ① and ② are both satisfied — G1 says no
real traffic before consent is live.
